name: override_abstract_strategy_v2_cups
abstraction_notice: Bounded strategy-only research model. Not official field geometry, a complete game simulator, CAD-conditioned capabilities, or evidence of a physically qualified VEX robot.

official_facts.yellow_ownership_rule: SC5: yellow scored pin halves in a quadrant goal belong to the alliance owning that quadrant's toggle.
official_facts.possession_rule: SG6: possession is limited to one Pin and one Cup independently.
official_facts.placement_rule: SC2: at most one pin half per goal or cup half; successive pins require cups.
official_facts.scoring_unit: SC3: each visible half of a placed pin is evaluated by color; this model counts exactly one visible half per pin token.

excluded: full pin-half visibility and cup-orientation simulation

assumptions.notice: Every coordinate, goal height/capacity, stock count, start position, timing/noise model, ownership initialization, and resource budget below is an authored abstract assumption, not official geometry or validated engineering.

capability_model.notice: Sample once before the episode from a drive/handling/lift Dirichlet simplex. This is an abstract resource tradeoff, not a VEX hardware feasibility claim.
capability_model.payload_capacity: 1 pin, independently of a maximum of 1 cup (SG6)

noise.opponent_process: Independent homogeneous Poisson recaptures per toggle; pre-sampled with a separate RNG stream before the episode, including events while neutral/opponent-owned.
noise.event_order: Process recaptures through action end time first, then apply a completed successful player action.

semantics.goal_height: base_height_m + height_per_pin_m * current_total_pin_count; test reach before each placement; no height bonus
semantics.pin_token: One legal pin oriented so exactly one selected alliance/yellow half is counted. The other half is ignored. This is a bounded SC3 scoring abstraction, not a claim to simulate all possible half scoring.
semantics.cup_stack: First pin may enter an empty goal. Every further pin requires cup_ready at that goal; pin placement clears cup_ready. A cup may be placed only on a nonempty stack without a ready cup. Cup placement costs placement time and success probability, earns no direct points, and preserves previously counted halves through an assumed correct clear-side orientation. No cup/pin geometry or stability is verified.
semantics.cup_inventory: At most one cup independently of at most one pin; each supply starts with six cups. Cups use acquisition timing/probability. Cup and pin placement both require goal reach and remaining pin capacity.
semantics.movement: Straight-line travel with turn overhead. Failed moves progress by a sampled fraction; deadline truncation preserves only time-feasible progress after turning.
semantics.midfield: Exact abstract site membership. Award once at any terminal state when at midfield. park_and_wait is available there in the final 15 seconds and waits through all remaining recaptures.
semantics.invalid_action: Consumes one wait interval and one step, with no player effect. Opponent recaptures and terminal scoring still apply.
semantics.horizon: At max_steps, advance the remaining match clock without player action before terminal scoring, so terminal points and ownership are evaluated at 105 seconds.
semantics.reward: Actual modeled score_after minus score_before, including losses of yellow ownership and terminal midfield points. No shaping or reward scaling.
